final: WITH m AS (SELECT r.staff_id AS staff_id, p.amount AS amount FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id), g AS (SELECT staff_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM m GROUP BY staff_id), o AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS overall FROM g WHERE total IS NOT NULL) SELECT g.staff_id, g.total, g.total / o.overall AS share FROM g JOIN o ON o.overall IS NOT NULL ORDER BY g.staff_id
